Comparing the number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain in a human, pig and mouse.
Human :
```{r}
sum(180,83,57,110)
```
Pig:
```{r}
sum(109,31,157,45)
```
Mouse:
```{r}
sum(55,185,60,98)
```
Therefore, humans had the highest number of genes, then the mouse and then the pig.
